args:
while true; do
  i=0
  while [ $i -lt 30000 ]; do i=$((i+1)); done
  sleep 1
done
containers.name: worker

args: while true; do i=0; while [ $i -lt 1000000 ]; do i=$((i+1)); done; done
containers.name: encoder
mongo-insert

command:
M="mysql -h mysql-0.mysql -u root fixture"
until $M -e "select 1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 5; done
$M -e "create table if not exists ticks (id bigint auto_increment primary key, ts timestamp(3) default current_timestamp(3), payload varchar(64))"
n=0
while true; do
  $M -e "insert into ticks (payload) values (md5(rand()))" || echo "insert failed $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
  n=$((n+1)); [ $((n % 60)) -eq 0 ] && echo "inserted $n $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
  sleep 1
done
containers.name: mysql-insert

command:
until pg_isready -q; do sleep 5; done
psql -tAc "select 1 from pgbench_branches limit 1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || pgbench -i -s 1 -q
while true; do
  pgbench -n -c 1 -j 1 -R 2 -T 300 -P 60 || sleep 10
done
containers.name: pgbench

$M -e "create table if not exists ticks (id bigint auto_increment primary key, ts timestamp(3) default current_timestamp(3), payload varchar(64))"
n=0
while true; do
  $M -e "insert into ticks (payload) values (md5(rand()))" || echo "insert failed $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
  n=$((n+1)); [ $((n % 60)) -eq 0 ] && echo "inserted $n $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
  sleep 1
done
containers.name: mysql-insert

command:
until pg_isready -q; do sleep 5; done
psql -tAc "select 1 from pgbench_branches limit 1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || pgbench -i -s 1 -q
while true; do
  pgbench -n -c 1 -j 1 -R 2 -T 300 -P 60 || sleep 10
done
containers.name: pgbench
